t: This is The Bailey's Hotel, on Gloucester Road in Kensington. Its main entrance is on Courtfield Road, opposite Gloucester Road tube station. It was established in 1876 and takes its name from its original owner, Sir James Bailey. He was a Conservative politician, Member of Parliament for Walworth from 1895 to 1906, and a successful hotel developer. He also founded the Constitutional Club, and Baileys Irish Cream is named for this hotel. Clara Thomas, a landowner and philanthropist, died here.
